title: B-CARE: Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2610.29350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stance classifiers make errors that can be costly to identify under limited human-review budgets. Prioritizing potentially incorrect predictions remains challenging, particularly across heterogeneous base models. We introduce B-CARE (Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking), a prediction-blind framework for identifying high-risk stance predictions. Given only a target and text, a fixed LLM verifier assigns ordinal evidence scores to all candidate stance labels without observing the base model's prediction or confidence. B-CARE constructs a comparative risk score by contrasting the strongest alternative-class evidence with the evidence supporting the predicted class. The resulting classwise evidence profile can be reused across multiple base models without training a separate error detector or calibrating risk scores. translated_title: B-CARE：用于立场错误排序的盲测类别相对证据评估
translated_abstract: 立场分类器所产生的错误在有限的人工审核预算下可能需要高昂代价才能识别出来。对潜在错误的预测进行优先级排序仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在异构的基础模型之间。我们提出了B-CARE（Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking，用于立场错误排序的盲测类别相对证据评估），这是一个用于识别高风险立场预测的预测盲框架。在仅给定目标和文本的情况下，一个固定的LLM验证器会为所有候选立场标签分配有序的证据分数，而无需观察基础模型的预测结果或置信度。B-CARE通过对比支持预测类别的证据与最强的替代类别证据，构建出一个比较性风险分数。由此产生的类别级证据画像可以在多个基础模型之间复用，而无需训练单独的错误检测器或校准风险分数。我们在四个立场基准和三个异构基础LLM上评估了B-CARE，涵盖……
tldr: B-CARE提出了一种预测盲的高风险立场错误排序框架，利用固定的LLM验证器对比各类立场标签之间的相对证据强度来构建风险分数，且证据画像可跨异构基础模型复用而无需额外训练错误检测器。
en_tdlr: B-CARE introduces a prediction-blind framework for ranking high-risk stance prediction errors by contrasting classwise relative evidence scores from a fixed LLM verifier, with evidence profiles reusable across heterogeneous base models without training separate error detectors.
